description:
## [1.36.0](https://github.com/dhrubonai/morphe-patches/releases/tag/v1.36.0) (2026-11-21)

### Bug Fixes

* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** fixed downloads saving the 22-second MovieBox upgrade ad instead of the actual video. Ported all latest fixes from hxreborn v1.83.0: stop downloads saving upgrade notice clip, remove offer popup and Home promotions, guard opaque and prefixed deep links, bypass blacklisted device ids, tag every request with X-Client-Build. Added support for 4.0.03.1028.03. **Users must re-patch their MovieBox APK.** Telegram popup and coffee button preserved.
